description: Adjusts video display aspect ratio across feeds and story cells: 'fit' ensures the entire video is visible without cropping, or 'fill' expands the video to fill the screen.
name: Video Fit

options.description: Aspect ratio mode for feed and story videos: 'fit' (entire video visible without crop), or 'fill' (crop to fill screen).
options.title: Video Fit Mode

description: Caps video playback resolution (1080p, 720p, 540p, 480p, 360p) to conserve battery, GPU/MediaCodec load, and mobile data. Download quality is controlled separately by the Media Usability patch (downloadQuality).
name: Video Quality Governor

options.description: Select maximum video playback resolution ceiling: 1080 (1080p ExtremelyHigh), 720 (720p SuperHigh), 540 (540p H_High), 480 (480p High), or 360 (360p Standard).
options.title: Maximum Playback Resolution

options.description: Drops ByteVC2 renditions from playback bitrate lists when an H.264 or ByteVC1 alternative exists, so videos use the hardware decoder instead of TikTok's CPU-bound ByteVC2 software decoder.
options.title: Avoid ByteVC2 Software Decoding

options.description: When the ladder's lowest video stream exceeds the device hardware decoder capability (queried via MediaCodecList), drops video streams and keeps audio-only instead of entering decoder-reject retry loops that freeze the device.
options.title: Drop Undecodable Video Streams

description: Strips on-device voice recognition and speech synthesis engines (libspeechspg.so, libspeechsdk.so) and their loader stubs (libspeechengine.so, libspeechepg.so) to save APK space. Breaks voice search (microphone button), voice input, and editor text-to-speech/sing features.
name: Voice & Speech Engine De-bloat

description: Kizu Twitch enhancements: third-party emotes, live ad blocking, appearance controls, deleted-message display, privacy controls, native Video Stats and single-tap Reload Stream, PurpleTV-style landscape brightness/volume gestures with swipe-to-portrait collapse prevention, Hide Stories, Go Ad-Free hiding, and patched-app compatibility.
name: Twitch Enhancement

description: Logs every Java ads-bridge entry via logcat (tag BOTW) for diagnosis. Proves whether the game reaches the Java layer. Disable for release builds.
name: Ads path tracer

description: Neutralizes the LuckyPatcher/signature guard so the re-signed app does not kill itself on launch. Does not grant items or currency.
name: Disable tamper guard

description: Forces the GMS static RewardedAd.isAdAvailable() probe to true so any direct static callers (bypassing the Unity bridge) also take the reward path. Pairs with the Skip patches; IAP purchases still require real payment.
name: Force GMS rewarded available

description: Routes Google sign-in through MicroG-RE 7.1.1+. Requires app.revanced.android.gms with the same Google account.
name: Google sign-in via MicroG-RE

description: Logs splash/login gate progress via logcat for diagnosis. Disable for release builds.
name: Login tracer

description: Disables Play Games sign-in so the game runs as guest without a Google login. Leaves the ads SDKs initializable so the local Skip patches can complete the reward flow. Does not grant items or currency.
name: Play offline (guest)

description: Forces the local Premium check to always pass. Does not activate a subscription on your account; server-gated features may still require a real purchase.
name: Premium

description: Completes the AdMob rewarded flow locally so the requested reward is granted without loading or playing an ad. Pairs with Skip rewarded ads (AppLovin MAX); IAP purchases still require real payment.
name: Skip AdMob rewarded ads

description: Completes the decagon AdMob rewarded flow locally so the requested reward is granted without loading or playing an ad. Pairs with Skip AdMob rewarded ads; IAP purchases still require real payment.
name: Skip decagon rewarded ads

description: Completes the rewarded-video flow locally so the requested reward is granted without playing an ad. No ad-network impression or revenue is synthesized; IAP purchases still require real payment.
name: Skip rewarded ads

dependencies: Dark Theme text field UI hooks
description: Dark native surfaces using Andes semantic colors; preserves brand colors, WebViews and business logic.
name: Dark Theme (native)

description: Recolors the server-selected Home canvas and action-card text after they render.
name: Dark Theme Home UI hooks

description: Recolors native menu section labels and separators after server styling.
name: Dark Theme menu UI hooks

description: Scoped CSS for Categories and the Home campaign's HTML surfaces, without media filters.
name: Dark Theme public WebViews

description: Uses a dark native background for the recommendations feed in its two render paths.
name: Dark Theme recommendations feed

description: Dark text field fills, borders, labels and values without changing input behavior.
name: Dark Theme text field UI hooks

description: Replaces YouTube's download action and Downloads page with a native cobalt manager.
name: Cobalt downloads

description: Waze rejects any display mode above 60 Hz when it picks the mode for its surface, so a 120 Hz screen is served 60 Hz. This raises that ceiling to the requested rate (120 Hz by default). Costs battery and heat - off by default.
name: Allow high refresh rate

options.description: The ceiling Waze accepts when choosing a display mode. 120 suits most modern panels; 90 or 60 to back off if the phone throttles.
options.title: Target refresh rate (Hz)

description: Pins Waze's own auto-zoom setting (no / yes / speed) and keeps it across server config sync. Waze ships the row itself; this makes the choice stick.
name: Auto zoom

options.description: speed = zoom out progressively with speed, yes = always on, no = off.
options.title: Auto-zoom mode

description: Enables average-speed camera alerts and recommended-speed guidance.
name: Average-speed camera alerts

description: Enables Waze's brief voice-guidance mode.
name: Brief voice guidance

description: Applies the configuration changes requested by the other patches. Applied automatically; there is nothing to configure.
name: Config overrides

description: Turns on Waze's police/enforcement alert system.
name: Enable police & enforcement alerts

description: Increases the pre-alert distances for police enforcement, accidents and heavy traffic.
name: Extended police & hazard alert distances

description: Enables lane guidance, including continue-straight hints.
name: Lane guidance

description: Plays speed-camera sound alerts even when not above the limit.
name: Radar sound at any speed

description: Forces Waze's advertising config values off.
name: Remove ads

description: Shows speed cameras, red-light cameras and speed bumps on the map and enables their notifications.
name: Show all cameras & road hazards

description: Forces the speed-limit sign on and enables the manual overrides.
name: Speed limit sign always shown

description: Enables warnings when the speed limit drops, with an extended pre-alert distance.
name: Speed-limit decrease warnings

description: Keeps the speedometer visible at any speed, including while stopped.
name: Speedometer always on

description: Replaces the official YouTube Music entry with your Morphe YouTube Music: the package Waze launches and the row label, at the single point every audio-partner list entry is built from - plus both launch paths as a fallback.
name: Wire Morphe YouTube Music into Waze

options.description: The package Waze asks for. Requests matching this prefix are rewritten.
options.title: Official YouTube Music package

options.description: The package your Morphe YouTube Music is installed as. Morphe Manager shows it on the app's patch screen.
options.title: Your Morphe YouTube Music package

options.description: What the list entry reads once it points at your build. Set it back to "YouTube Music" to leave the label as Waze ships it.
options.title: Row label in Waze's list
